mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_message (id, topic, event_key, payload, status, retry_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{topic}, #{eventKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), #{status}, COALESCE(#{retryCount}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, event_key, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$')) AS payload, status, retry_count, create_time FROM event_message WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE event_message SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE event_message SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= 3 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
